name: Bold lines only keeps the title
about: A bold title with a plain subtitle line under it: Pick for me reads bold lines only, and the title passage (which takes the subtitle in) is kept like scripture and quotes.

runs.text: Tell the story of the morning of the earthquake and the sound before it hit.
Everything that can be shaken will be shaken.
Talk about the things we thought were solid.
What God builds can’t be shaken.
